relationships.subject: icatibant
relationships.evidence_quote: Icatibant, a bradykinin B2 receptor antagonist, has demonstrated efficacy in adults and has emerging evidence in children.

relationships.subject: icatibant
relationships.evidence_quote: Icatibant was safe and effective in the pediatric studies, providing rapid symptoms relief and a favorable tolerability profile.

relationships.subject: bradykinin
relationships.evidence_quote: Hereditary angioedema (HAE) is a rare, potentially life-threatening bradykinin-mediated disorder

key_findings: Three open-label phase III studies (43 children) showed icatibant gave symptom relief at a median of about 1 hour and was well tolerated.
Self- or caregiver administration was feasible in adolescents.
